title: Al-Khuzāʿī’s commentary on al-Khwārizmī’s algebra
originalTitle: شرح مختصر الشيخ أبي بكر محمد بن موسى الخوارزمي في الجبر والمقابلة
repository: British Library, Oriental Manuscripts (digitized by Qatar Digital Library)
attribution: Qatar Digital Library / British Library, Delhi Arabic 1897
licence: Qatar Digital Library record states Public Domain
description: A digitized leaf from the Arabic commentary on al-Khwārizmī’s algebra. The commentary is attributed to Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Khuzāʿī; the surviving codex was copied in 1627. It is not an autograph by al-Khwārizmī.
connection: The text explicitly comments on al-Khwārizmī’s algebraic work; British Library catalogue records the contents and folio range.
